representation_separation.interpretation: Velocity-constraint time level versus end geometry is a representation effect, not an observer error. Canonical nominal rigid projections are not full measured-state certificates. No physics correction or true-state offset was inserted into Agent.

fixed_short_diagnostic.rate_alternatives: Decision-average, own-action endpoint, zero assumption and public motor-target assumption are distinguished.
fixed_short_diagnostic.limits: Canonical nominal rigid projection; raw measured representation residual reported separately. No measured-state admission certificate, and unrecorded joint rates are assumptions. Fixed recorded candidate actions only; no controller/threshold changes.

implemented_observer.joint: Public integer-polygon endpoint templates yield joint bins of at most0.004rad; same-time own-action prior is conditioned on the observed bin.
implemented_observer.speed_and_yaw: Source-pixel speed2.5m/s and yaw0.05rad/s bins replace biased point inversions; known renderer deadzones are retained; nonmatching HUD patterns retain explicitly unvalidated legacy fallback without a fabricated bin.
implemented_observer.end_state: Persist joint angle, endpoint joint rate and yaw from the original4tick own-action propagation. A decision-average angle difference is not labelled an instantaneous joint rate.
implemented_observer.flow: Transport the0.08s optical displacement/yaw-average innovation to the endpoint using own predicted average and endpoint motion; keep speed/yaw inside matching HUD bins.
implemented_observer.wheelspin: Still propagated using original dynamics and own actions. No measured wheelspin is injected; better kinematic observations reduce propagation drift.

public_checks.scope: Small fixed public HUD/Box2D fixtures, not a universal observer or safety guarantee.

prospective_gate.rationale: A preventive reset trial was predeclared after independent public dynamics error reductions and the admitted initial full-Agent cache. Terminal canonical projections with measured observables were explicitly not interpreted as proof of physical infeasibility.

new_failure_evidence.conclusion: Measured-vehicle substitution does not change rejection; actual map admits with either estimated or measured observable state. Further state-value adjustment is not justified by this checkpoint; remaining blocker is map geometry.

next_gate: Do not repeat the same rollout for another state tweak. Diagnose the six forecast footprint rejections against observed-map uncertainty/geometry with the new accurate observer held fixed, before any further reset; no original-threshold/physics/chooser change.
privacy: Code, public synthetic tables/tests and aggregate results only. No actual map, seed, raw pixels or measured state snapshot is committed.
